title: PLANETARIUM UNDER THE BROWSER — THIS garden into the mesh. petalTongue between rock and hard place. map displayed UP.

this.what: the pale disk overlay — Discovering the garden Stage 3: discovery. a window that is NOT the tab.
this.into_the_mesh: seat it. do not leave it as a tourist chrome. it is a face of the same render organ.
this.seen: 2026-10-24 over Cursor + NVIDIA. circle on black. search glyph. stage 3.

do_not_reinvent.pt: petalTongue — any data to any representation. already the organ. discovery crate already exists.
do_not_reinvent.footPrint: bridges petalTongue to the web. sinew. not the renderer.
do_not_reinvent.veil: /data/veil-phylogeny-exude.json — browser chrome can be clothes. the disk is not paint.

petalTongue_is_the_between.yes: petalTongue renderer IS the thing between the rock and the hard place
petalTongue_is_the_between.rock: the window object — OS HWND / wgpu surface / GPU (the NVIDIA face in the shot)
petalTongue_is_the_between.hard_place: the browser / IDE chrome — the tab, the address bar, the clothes
petalTongue_is_the_between.dock: petalTongue sits BETWEEN. native surface under (or beside) the tab. object seated in the chrome's room without becoming the chrome.
petalTongue_is_the_between.not: a webpage pretending to be a sky. not a sixth body. the tongue that speaks any data as a surface.

window_under_the_browser.yes: that between is WHAT ALLOWS a window under the browser
window_under_the_browser.under: compositor layer. the tab is veil. the native window is skin/rock. you can see a disk that is not a DOM node.
window_under_the_browser.this_shot: the garden overlay is already that class — it floats over the IDE, it is not the chat transcript
window_under_the_browser.mesh_job: tie THIS class to petalTongue (discovery + ui + platform + wasm). footPrint translates. the tongue renders.

planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.yes: a planetarium IS a map displayed UP
planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.UP: dome / sky / you lean back. stars painted on the inside of a sphere over your head.
planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.DOWN: table map / floor plan / you lean in. gardens, LAN, cairns, the hard place as a plate.
planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.THIS_disk: pale circle on black = looking UP at a moon-dome. Stage 3 discovery is the sky-map of the garden, not the dirt-map.
planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.pair: planetarium UP + garden map DOWN = two projections of one mesh. Klein: same surface, two looks.
planetarium_is_map_displayed_UP.not: do not pick UP XOR DOWN. dock them. the tongue can speak both.

into_the_mesh.crate_already: petal-tongue-discovery — the garden stage already has a house
into_the_mesh.stamp: exuded render vs painted chrome. THIS disk is exuded if it is a real surface. painted if it is only a splash.
into_the_mesh.nvidia: the GPU logo in the shot is the rock's badge — not the planetarium. do not confuse the driver overlay with the dome.

berry_at_the_fire: get THIS into our mesh, with the petalTongue renderer. it is the thing between the rock and the hard place. that is what allows a window under the browser. and yes — a planetarium is a map displayed UP. the pale disk is the dome. the garden dirt is DOWN. same mesh, two looks.
next: when petalTongue discovery paints a surface, stamp UP (planetarium) or DOWN (garden map). do not let the browser tab claim it is the only window.
